headline.text: L2 flow-wrap changeover delayed to Monday on missing part; L1 Sollich 2 ran out of wrap stock and will finish *140,000 pieces short* of order

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 ran out of jars at 17:26, paused for 90 minutes until Orem warehouse delivery arrived. Sollich 2 exhausted flow wrap inventory mid-shift and will finish 140,000 pieces short of the 302,000-piece order due to on-hold material in Springville. Sollich 4 had a salt spill at 22:14 that required line pause and CILTs; 4 boxes scrapped. Water gun in dishwashing area 2 is splitting and poses a safety risk.
per_plant_summary.L2: Molding Line 2 flow-wrap changeover to Caramel Hearts is incomplete — maintenance missing a bracket bar that should have been in the kit. Line will not run Saturday; changeover deferred to Monday. Molding Line 3 had recurring label-switch issues through 2nd shift (sensor couldn't read wide rolls); PG19 adjustment at 17:26 resolved. FFS pouch line experienced brief film-adhesion trouble at end of 2nd shift.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 depositor 4 consistently built up sensor residue requiring multiple cleaning pauses. Mold insertion tilting issue resolved overnight by limiting fill to half-capacity. At 07:31 1st shift discovered depositor 4 stopped sending dark chocolate inclusion — more than half the cooler affected, product scrapped. 53 caddies rejected for underweight bars at 01:17, current product back in range. ML1 C1 belt has a significant tear; maintenance checking for spare. Truffle line received coconut oil totes with incompatible valve fittings; 9 of 17 totes can't connect without adapters.

notes.text: South tray printer on Sollich 3 was knocked over at 14:18, breaking the sensor connector; Troy replaced with spare and flagged ~12 trays for rework.
New jar lids arrived warped and initially wouldn't run on the capper; later boxes performed better and issue appears isolated.
Saturday schedule email attachment shows outdated content from July; Maria/Daniel to correct.
Sweco on ML1 is showing micro holes and wear; Nathan flagged for monitoring and future replacement.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 jar shortage halted line for 90 minutes
resolved.summary: Line exhausted jar inventory at 17:26 and sent team to lunch while waiting for emergency delivery from Orem warehouse.
resolved.resolution: Jars arrived from Orem at 19:34, line restarted — "Jars are here. We are starting the line again now." (William Beattie)

resolved.title: Sollich 4 tempering unit fault blocked caramel drain
resolved.summary: Drain pipe wouldn't heat at 00:03; when attempting to push at 23:00 PSI spiked to 300 and tempering unit 1 faulted.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:25 — Maintenance reset the fault, pipes reheated, caramel drained successfully and level 2 clean began.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 south tray printer sensor broken in fall
resolved.summary: Printer was knocked over and landed on the sensor connector, breaking it; approximately 12 trays printed incorrectly.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:18 — Troy replaced sensor with spare on hand; flagged affected trays for rework.

resolved.title: Sollich 4 salt spill contaminated product in tunnel
resolved.summary: Operator dropped salt jar on conveyor belt, covering a batch with excessive salt; line paused for cleanup and CILTs.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 22:29 — Supervisor pulled all affected product from tunnel 1; 4 boxes packaged were scrapped, no hold inventory.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 caramels bouncing and flipping on belt
resolved.summary: Caramels transitioning from enrober to pack were bouncing and standing on end, causing Cavanna jams and accumulation.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:47 — Maintenance dropped line speed from 34 to 25 mpm; operator paused to clear bins, then resumed.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 labeler A incompatible with current jars
resolved.summary: Labeler A wasn't working well with the jar and label combination for MMK caramels.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:33 — "We have set up labeler B for the MMK caramels for S2 and it's running better." (Justin Garner)

resolved.title: ML3 label-switch sensor couldn't read wide film rolls
resolved.summary: Flow-wrap sensor repeatedly failed to detect eye-marks on wider-than-spec label rolls (PG11), causing line stops through 2nd shift.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 17:49 — Maintenance adjusted PG19 at 17:26; "First roll switch after the adjustment goes well."

resolved.title: FFS pouch machine lost correct cut on new film roll
resolved.summary: After installing a new roll of film at ~15:52, the machine wouldn't assume the correct pouch cut length.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:03 — "The pouch looks better!" after maintenance intervention; no defective product packaged (Marlenis).

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 4 leaking chocolate at nozzle plate
resolved.summary: Depositor 4 leaked chocolate at the nozzle plate gasket; tightening the bolt didn't stop the leak.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:00 — Line stopped to check gasket, refilled and tested with no leaks; "QA checked as well we are starting up."

resolved.title: ML4 mold insertion tilting and jamming line
resolved.summary: Mold insertion assembly motor and bracket broke free, causing tilting, back-door opening, and repeated line stops starting at 19:59.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 02:02 — Maintenance marked a half-capacity fill line on the chute; "Issue with mold insertion resolved. New instructions are to not fill new molds beyond half-way mark."

resolved.title: ML4 mold jam at demolding section
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 11:44 due to mold jam in the demolding area.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:48 — "Area its clean and mold jam it's fixed. Line star running again." (ML4 TG)

resolved.title: ML4 53 caddies rejected for underweight bars
resolved.summary: Roughly 53 ten-bar caddies were auto-rejected due to low weight; some bars appeared underweight.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:36 — "Current bars coming out of the Demolding belt are within weight range. Operator is making sure none of the low weight caddies make it to the master case." (Gina)

resolved.title: ML1 hopper seal out of place during inspection
resolved.summary: Maintenance inspecting the Imperial hopper for leaks found the seal displaced; hopper was removed and washed.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:37 — "They removed the hopper and washed it and seal was replaced." (Jose Vasquez)

resolved.title: ML4 multiple brief gondola entrance jams
resolved.summary: Gondola entrance jammed twice during 1st shift, each time cleared within 2–3 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:39 — Technicians tested and verified, line back running.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 ran out of flow wrap, will finish 140k short
needs_attention.summary: No flow-wrap stock remains in L1; 130,000 pieces available in Springville are on hold due to quality (material breaks easily, weak adhesive). Line will finish ~160,000 of the 302,000-piece order.
needs_attention.status: Team will run remaining inventory then prepare line for MMK jars. 140,000-piece shortfall confirmed as of 03:52.

needs_attention.title: Damaged ingredient containers blocking stir on Sollich 4
needs_attention.summary: Multiple ingredient totes arrived with damaged frames and torn netting, making it unsafe or impossible to stir contents.
needs_attention.status: Katya noted at 12:35 that warehouse may need training on handling; no vendor contact or replacement totes confirmed.

needs_attention.title: Cooling tunnel 1 belt tear on Sollich 2
needs_attention.summary: Lead noticed an issue in tunnel 1 belt at 05:05 on 2nd shift; no details on severity or location.
needs_attention.status: Photo posted at 05:05; no maintenance response or work order visible in window.

needs_attention.title: Dishwashing area 2 water gun splitting, safety risk
needs_attention.summary: The water gun in dishwashing area 2 is splitting and could pose a safety hazard to operators.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 08:16; no follow-up posted in the window.

needs_attention.title: Nuts found on floor in surrounding area
needs_attention.summary: Charity flagged nuts on the floor in a surrounding area at 12:16.
needs_attention.status: No follow-up cleanup confirmation or root-cause posted.

needs_attention.title: ML2 flow-wrap changeover incomplete, missing bracket bar
needs_attention.summary: Maintenance cannot finish the flow-wrap changeover for Caramel Hearts because a mounting bar is missing from the kit; part should have been in the box but wasn't found.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance reached out to Dave Ruff; no resolution by end of shift. Changeover deferred to Monday per Gustavo at 07:12.

needs_attention.title: FFS one film roll failed adhesive bond at shift end
needs_attention.summary: A single roll of film at the end of 2nd shift did not hold to the adhesive strips on the pouch machine.
needs_attention.status: Brandon placed defective roll sample on Ethan Bean's desk for vendor follow-up.

needs_attention.title: ML3 flow-wrap vacuum missing two mounting bolts
needs_attention.summary: Two bolts are missing from the vacuum assembly on the flow-wrap machine.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 02:58 with photo; no maintenance response in window.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 4 stopped sending dark chocolate inclusion
needs_attention.summary: At 07:31 1st shift discovered depositor 4 was not dispensing dark chocolate cookie inclusion into bars; over half the cooler affected and being scrapped.
needs_attention.status: Team drained all inclusion hopper and depositor to start fresh at 06:44. Preston at 08:26 reminded team to fully purge depositor during downtime. More than half cooler scrapped as of 08:18.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line coconut oil totes have incompatible valves
needs_attention.summary: 9 of 17 new coconut oil totes arrived with a different valve configuration than the two existing types; team cannot connect them without adapters.
needs_attention.status: Tyson added action at 18:13; Angel will send photos and details to Preston for procurement follow-up Monday. 8 totes usable, 9 blocked.

needs_attention.title: ML4 sticker machine not working correctly
needs_attention.summary: The sticker applicator is malfunctioning; line was down at 18:24.
needs_attention.status: Shane posted line down at 18:24; no follow-up resolution or maintenance update in window.

needs_attention.title: ML4 many molds not demolding fully
needs_attention.summary: Operators seeing high volume of molds returned because product is not demolding completely.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 23:49 by 3rd shift; no corrective action or root cause posted.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 4 screws loose, over-depositing chocolate
needs_attention.summary: Loose screws on depositor 4 caused it to pour excessive chocolate into molds.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 04:02; operator noticed while depositing. No tightening or inspection follow-up posted.

needs_attention.title: ML4 bad molds not auto-rejecting on TG
needs_attention.summary: A few defective molds that were marked in the system did not get rejected by the vision system.
needs_attention.status: Kimberly posted photos of marked-but-not-rejected molds at 04:12; no QA or maintenance investigation visible.

needs_attention.title: ML1 C1 belt has significant tear
needs_attention.summary: The belt after the metal detector (C1 belt) on ML1 has a good-sized tear.
needs_attention.status: Jose Vasquez in maintenance notified at 04:57; checking for spare belt on hand. No confirmation of availability.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line chocolate exit temp running above standard
needs_attention.summary: Chocolate exit temperature climbed 0.3°C since start of shift and is now at 26.3°C, outside the 25.5°C standard.
needs_attention.status: Shawn at 07:45 says action exists to adjust mixing water to keep between 25–26°C; at 26.3 product likely okay but needs monitoring.

needs_attention.title: ML1 sweco screen showing wear with micro holes
needs_attention.summary: The sweco screen is starting to show wear with visible micro holes; not yet a concern but should be monitored for replacement timing.
needs_attention.status: Nathan flagged at 03:08 for future watch; no inspection interval or replacement criteria posted.

needs_attention.title: ML4 gondola C6 belt tracking to north side
needs_attention.summary: The C6 conveyor belt in the gondola has tracked north twice; Peter adjusted but suspects dirty rollers or belt may be the root cause.
needs_attention.status: Itzel posted at 10:05 that Peter adjusted but cleaning may be needed; no follow-up cleaning scheduled.
